description: Floor to ceiling in small drawers, each one hand-labelled in a script that stopped being legible around the letter M. Rope on spools, blades under glass, a wall of hand tools hung on pegs in size order. The whole room smells of oil and hot metal, and there is a running argument in chalk on the back wall about whether a thing counts as fixed if it only works when you hold it.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
